definitions: A system of rails, typically made of metal, installed along the edge of a road, bridge, or other dangerous area to prevent vehicles or people from falling off or straying.
A set of principles, rules, or limits that provide guidance or prevent unacceptable behaviour or outcomes.
examples: The car crashed into the guardrails.
The project has strong guardrails to ensure data privacy.
Safety guardrails were installed along the cliff path.
